name: Jacketee WebMCP
description: Machine-readable actions and entry points for Jacketee customer support, product discovery, custom jacket inquiries, and order help.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Jacketee products and categories by keyword.

query.description: Product, category, material, color, or style keyword.

tools.name: send_contact_message
tools.description: Send a support, custom jacket, or bulk order inquiry to Jacketee.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to Jacketee updates and offers.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Open the order tracking page for order status lookup.

tools.name: request_return
tools.description: Open the return request form for eligible stock jacket returns.
